zoe (Finance): Heads-up — ChannelX submitted a credit application for Apr invoices claiming duplicate marketplace usage after they migrated to the reseller flow. They attached a CSV. @mike can you triage? :eyes:

mike (BillingOps): Got it. Can you paste 2-3 sample rows inline? need invoice IDs, partner order IDs, SKU mapping.

zoe (Finance): Sure — pasted their sample below:

```
invoice_id,partner_order_id,marketplace_sku,reported_tokens,charge_usd
inv-2024-04-312,ord-7753,redwood-gen-8k,1,234.50
inv-2024-04-312,ord-7753,redwood-gen-8k,1,234.50
inv-2024-04-498,ord-7821,embed-plus,0,0.00
```

aws-billing-bot: AWS Marketplace report match: 2 potential duplicates found for inv-2024-04-312. Link: https://console.aws/marketplace/report/ABC123

mike (BillingOps): Looks like duplicate line items got re-ingested during partner migration. Next steps: 1) confirm original marketplace invoice IDs 2) reconcile PartnerX usage file vs our ingestion logs 3) if duplicate, propose credit amount. @tara will credits > $5k need Sales signoff?

tara (SalesOps): Yes — >$5k requires Sales manager approval and partner SLA review. I can provisionally approve up to $5k. Please include partner PoR and migration ticket.

sophie (Revenue Ops): For accounting, flag GL code REB-CR-2024 and include original revenue recognition dates. We need the credit in May close if approved. Also, add the credit memo reason code: "duplicate_ingestion_after_reseller_migration"

jared (Legal): Quick note — per our Channel Partner Agreement section 7.2, retro credits beyond 60 days need PO or amendment. Do we have migration date? If >60 days, legal needs partner consent.

mike (BillingOps): Migration kickoff = 2024-03-27 per migration ticket MIT-432. That puts these invoices within 60 days. I'll run ingestion diff and attach the reconciliation CSV by EOD.

zoe (Finance): Great. Action items: @mike run reconciliation + propose credit amount; @tara hold provisional approval up to $5k; @jared will confirm legal if we need partner signature; @sophie ready GL mapping. Target internal deadline: 2024-05-03 for decision so accounting can book in May close.

mike (BillingOps): Will upload reconciliation: S3 link s3://redwood-billing/recons/channelx/1915004321-recon.csv by 18:00 PT.

tara (SalesOps): :white_check_mark: I'll prepare approval note if under $5k; ping me ASAP when amount there.

zoe (Finance): Thanks — keep thread updated. If we need to escalate to partner PM, I'll schedule a 15m sync. :calendar:
